questions.stem: Which of the following is correct about the Philadelphia chromosome?

options.label: A
options.text: Balanced translocation between long arms of chromosome 9 and 22

options.label: B
options.text: Balanced translocation between short arms of chromosome 9 and 22

options.label: C
options.text: Unbalanced translocation between long arms of chromosome 9 and 22

options.label: D
options.text: Unbalanced translocation between short arms of chromosome 9 and 22
